newsitem.title: USA: InSite Phase I ISV-205 trial successful.
newsitem.headline: InSite Phase I ISV-205 trial successful.

text.p: InSite Vision Inc said Wednesday that it has successfully completed a Phase I human clinical study of its ISV-205 product candidate, a formulation of the anti-inflammatory drug diclofenac.
The company said it plans to pursue further development and, eventually, licensing of ISV-205 and other compounds if initial clinical efficacy is demonstrated.
In a statement, Insite said ISV-205 contains diclofenac in concentrations higher than the currently sold 0.1 percent formulation.

InSite believes higher concentrations may block steroid-induced elevation of intraocular pressure (IOP) without causing ocular redness and irritation. Elevated IOP can lead to glaucoma, a leading cause of blindness.

The Phase I study evaluated the safety and comfort of concentrations as high as 0.6 percent ISV-205 in healthy volunteers. InSite said it plans to evaluate these higher concentrations in Phase II studies beginning next year to determine efficacy in preventing IOP elevation associated with steroid use.
